observations.summary: Reuters reports HERCA, WENRA and NORA, representing regulators in 38 countries, jointly warned of increasing nuclear-safety risk from attacks on Ukraine's electricity infrastructure. IAEA had separately reported recent grid instability and reduced nuclear plant output. This is a newly published formal risk warning, not evidence that an accident has occurred or that a nationwide blackout is imminent.
observations.title: Nuclear safety regulators warn Ukrainian grid attacks are increasing winter nuclear accident risk
